rule: A frontier entry the campaign cannot close without inventing data is acknowledged here, never left silent. Each row names the champion, the coarse source, the blocking slots, the cached sentence that describes those hits, precisely what that sentence fails to say, and a reason: unsourced (the cache is silent) or certification_shape (the source states it; the certification rule refuses the shape). scripts/coverage_census.py fails two ways against this file: on an entry no row acknowledges, and on a row whose entry no longer reproduces - so the list can neither grow in silence nor outlive its cause.
why_these_cannot_close: The Everlasting scan certifies a timed fight only when every damaging ability event carries a reviewed crowd-control kind. MODULE_CC now names every slot a module emits, so a slot reaches that ledger unless its own control has no answer to state: each row below is a slot whose control varies within the cast and whose parts cannot carry the kinds apart, or whose control belongs to stack state no single cast applies. Authoring a cadence or a branch the source does not give would be inventing data, which this campaign's own banned shortcuts forbid. The 10 rows carry two different reasons: 9 are unsourced - the cache is silent about an instant or a branch, and they stay closed until the source says more. 1 is certification_shape (Yone E) - the source does state the missing piece, and its what_it_omits text opens with nothing: it is potentially closable by changing how certification reads an engine-built event, with no new data required.

acknowledged.cached_sentence: Targets beyond a certain range are also slowed by 50% for 0.5 seconds. ... The shuriken marks and reveals the enemy for 3 seconds, during which Shuriken Flip can be recast
acknowledged.what_it_omits: the range that decides whether Q slows at all, which a single-target model cannot place; and when the recast happens, which is player-chosen inside a window

acknowledged.cached_sentence: Flash Frost can be recast while the ice is in flight after its cast time, and does so automatically at maximum range
acknowledged.what_it_omits: the target's distance for Q (speed is cached, range is not). R's ticks ARE authored; its chill is held back deliberately, because declaring it would make Anivia the roster's first enhanced_consume producer and answer a ruling reserved for its own slice.

acknowledged.cached_sentence: Energized: Annie empowers her next cast of Disintegrate, Incinerate, or Summon: Tibbers to consume all Pyromania stacks to stun enemies hit
acknowledged.what_it_omits: which cast stuns; the stun follows a four-stack counter, so no slot-wide kind is true of any of the three

acknowledged.cached_sentence: Ablaze Bonus: The target is stunned for 1.75 seconds. ... Ablaze Bonus: The target is slowed for 0.25 seconds.
acknowledged.what_it_omits: which cast controls; the opening cast applies Ablaze and controls nothing, every later one does. R's bounce cadence is already authored - the kind alone is unstatable.

acknowledged.cached_sentence: Kennen's abilities apply a stack of Mark of the Storm ... The third stack against a target consumes them all to stun them for 1.25 seconds
acknowledged.what_it_omits: which ability lands the third stack. R's own six-bolt cadence is sourced and authored, and still has nothing true to carry.

acknowledged.cached_sentence: remaining ... as a controllable clone for up to 18 seconds. The clone will explode upon dying or expiring
acknowledged.what_it_omits: when the clone dies; 'up to 18 seconds' caps its life rather than timing the explosion

acknowledged.cached_sentence: Xayah recalls all planted Feathers to shoot back to her, each dealing physical damage. A target hit by at least three Feathers is rooted for 1.25 seconds.
acknowledged.what_it_omits: when each feather arrives; the root is a property of the count, not of the slot

acknowledged.cached_sentence: empowers his next three basic attacks on-attack within 5 seconds ... The third attack knocks up the target
acknowledged.what_it_omits: the interval between the three attacks, which are attack-speed paced and uncached - and the three do not control alike, so no slot-wide kind is true

acknowledged.cached_sentence: Yone dashes back to his body ... consuming the marks ... to deal true damage equal to the total amount of damage stored
acknowledged.what_it_omits: nothing about timing - the cache times it and the module prices it there. The event is built by the fight engine from stored damage, so the module authors no part for a kind to ride.

acknowledged.cached_sentence: Zyra plants a Seed at the target location that remains for 60 seconds
acknowledged.what_it_omits: anything about plant attacks at all - their damage, cadence and control live on the wiki's pets page, and Thorn Spitters control nothing where Vine Lashers slow, which the plant count cannot tell apart
